document.body:
Meeting Title: Customer data migration cutover planning
Meeting Date: 2026-11-06

Camila Torres: Camila Torres: Let's anchor the discussion on scope and expected outcome. What has actually changed since the last check-in?
Ryan Mitchell: Ryan Mitchell: The current picture is the rehearsal completed, but two address fields still need a mapping decision. We have the dry run moved 98.7 percent of records and preserved the source totals, and the signal I am watching is the remaining 1.3 percent is concentrated in legacy regional formats.
Anika Desai: Anika Desai: My concern is a cutover before reconciliation could create duplicate or incomplete customer profiles. If the data governance team must approve the normalized address format, what do we tell the people relying on this work?
George Allen: George Allen: We can quarantine ambiguous rows and reconcile counts before switching reads to the new store. We should keep whether blank legacy region codes should remain blank or use a reviewed mapping visible until that check is complete.
Camila Torres: Camila Torres: For the record, do not schedule production cutover until the address mapping and rollback rehearsal pass. Ryan Mitchell will sample the regional exceptions and document a tested rollback sequence before the next cutover review; whether blank legacy region codes should remain blank or use a reviewed mapping remains unresolved.
Camila Torres: Camila Torres: Before we move on, can we separate verified progress from assumptions about work completed since the last checkpoint?

Anika Desai: Anika Desai: I want to challenge one assumption: a cutover before reconciliation could create duplicate or incomplete customer profiles. Do we have evidence that the fallback will work?
George Allen: George Allen: A practical next step is to preserve the original value in an audit field while mapping only validated cases. That gives us evidence without committing beyond what we know.
Camila Torres: Camila Torres: What I am hearing is: do not schedule production cutover until the address mapping and rollback rehearsal pass.
